The team comprises engineers, designers, and venture builders who partner with industry experts to design, build, and launch disruptive technology products. Mayfly's core capabilities span venture building, solution design (UX/UI design, UX research, business process mapping, and product strategy), and full product development including MVP delivery, AI agent development, mobile applications, and SaaS platforms.

The studio works with both established businesses and growth-stage startups, specialising in rapidprototyping and iterative product development to help clients achieve product-market fit and reduce the technical barriers between idea and execution.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Mayfly Ventures is seeking an experienced Developer Programmer to join our team on a full-time basis. This is a hands-on, end-to-end product delivery role in which you will architect, design, build, and maintain web and mobile applications across concurrent client and in-house venture projects.
You will work closely with founders, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into high-quality, scalable software solutions, leveraging modern no-code platforms, AI tooling, and best-practice software development methods.

• Lead end-to-end design and development of web and mobile applications, managing priorities, timelines, and delivery across multiple concurrent projects

application functionality

• Demonstrated experience integrating REST APIs and third-party services into production application environments
• Strong UI/UX design capability including wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity interface design using tools such as Figma

• Experience applying Agile methodologies and using project management tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or Trello

Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for Electroplaters to be based at our NSW Office. We offer full-time permanent employment and short-term 3-6 months' non-ongoing contracts.

Surface Preparation: Cleaning, degreasing, pickling, and etching metal parts to remove rust, scale, and oil, ensuring proper coating adhesion
Process Control: Setting up and operating plating machinery, including adjusting electrical currents (voltage/amperage), temperature, and immersion times
Chemical Management: Preparing, monitoring, and maintaining electrolytic solutions to the objects to be coated. Test and adjust plating solutions to maintain desired specifications
Quality Inspection: Inspecting finished products for defects (e.g., bubbles, uneven coverage) and measuring coating thickness using tools like micrometers
Equipment Maintenance: Cleaning tanks, maintaining hoists, and repairing machinery, such as replacing anodes or cleaning ventilation systems

Physical ability to lift heavy metal products and operate machinery

Experience in maintaining electroplating/ galvanising equipment and troubleshooting issues
Strong knowledge of hazardous materials and safety equipment (respirators, protective clothing)
Good communication skills and ability to work in a team environment

Position: Machine Operator, Steel/Metal Industry
Location: Marrickville
Days: Mon-Fri
Hours: 38
Pay: $33+ casual rate with potential to go FT perm
Start: ASAP
 
Summary
We are seeking a skilled and dedicated Machine Operator to join our clients team in the steel industry. As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for operating and maintaining a variety of metalworking machinery to produce high-quality metal products. Your attention to detail, technical expertise, and commitment to safety will play a crucial role in our manufacturing process.
 
Company
Based in Marrickville, our company specializes in the production of a diverse range of metal products, including tables, chairs, trolleys, and other innovative solutions. They pride in their commitment to quality craftsmanship and cutting-edge design.
 
Responsibilities
* Set up and prepare metalworking machines, including lathes, milling machines, grinders, presses, and CNC machines, for production according to specifications.
* Operate machinery to shape, cut, form, or assemble metal components used in the production of a wide range of metal products, including but not limited to Connoisseur Racks, Display Racks, Primat Racks, Strip Racks, Brackets, and Clips, ensuring adherence to quality standards and production schedules.
* Monitor machine operations and conduct regular inspections to verify product accuracy and quality, making adjustments as needed.
* Perform routine maintenance tasks on machines, including cleaning, lubricating, and replacing worn parts to ensure optimal performance.
* Follow safety guidelines and protocols rigorously to maintain a safe working environment and prevent accidents.
* Collaborate with team members, supervisors, and engineers to communicate production updates, issues, and improvements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues, such as machine malfunctions, material inconsistencies, or quality deviations, to minimize downtime.
* Maintain accurate records of production data, machine settings, maintenance activities, and any encountered issues.
* Continuously seek opportunities for process improvement and efficiency enhancement in machine operation and product quality.
* Adhere to company policies, procedures, and guidelines to maintain a productive and positive work environment.
 
Requirements
* Experience as a Machine Operator in the metal industry, with an understanding of metalworking machinery and techniques (Desirable - Training to be provided by employer)
* Proficiency in operating and troubleshooting various metalworking machines
* Solid mechanical aptitude and technical skills to perform routine maintenance and address minor mechanical issues.
* Attention to detail and precision in following instructions, measurements, and specifications.
* Excellent problem-solving skills to identify issues and implement effective solutions.
* Strong commitment to safety protocols and guidelines.
* Effective communication skills to interact with team members, supervisors, and engineers.
* Physical stamina to stand for extended periods, lift heavy materials, and perform repetitive tasks.
* Flexibility to adapt to changing production demands and learn new techniques or machinery.
* Willingness to engage in ongoing training and professional development.

Warehouse Academy is facilitating recruitment on behalf of our client. The successful applicant will be employed and paid directly by the client. Warehouse Academy is a recruitment coordination service only and is not the employer for this role.

About the Role
Our client is a leading steel fabricator specializing in large-scale structural projects bridges, mining infrastructure, and commercial buildings. We are recruiting an experienced Welder to join their team and deliver high-integrity welds on heavy steel sections to exact engineering specifications.

• Finish products by grinding, filing, polishing, and cleaning weld zones; apply protective coatings or acid baths as per project standards.

• Minimum two years’ welding experience in structural steel fabrication; relevant trade certificate (or equivalent) and current welding certifications.

• Capable of welding in all positions on heavy plate and sections; comfortable operating overhead cranes and workshop machinery.
